name: Tyler Woods
career_history: Senior Preconstruction Manager at Adolfson & Peterson Construction, 4/2025 to present; Estimator at Adolfson & Peterson Construction, 2/2015 to present; Assistant Project Manager at Holder Construction, 8/2012 to 12/2014
education: Bachelor's degree, Construction Management, Auburn University, 2007 to 2012
biography:
I have a total of 7 years experience. 4 years in the field and 4 years in preconstruction.

During my time in college I was a in Co-Operative education program while at Auburn University. While in college, I worked full time with general contractors while also taking a full load in school. This early experience immensely helped me to be prepared as soon as i graduated college.

After I graduated I was hired as a Project Engineer by Holder Construction Company headquartered in Atlanta. Holder immediately cross-trained me to be a field engineer as well as a field BIM engineer. While with Holder, I worked on a $45 million dollar data Center for Discover Card in Columbus Ohio. Once construction completed, Holder moved me to Denver Colorado to work on a $60 million dollar data center for Time Warner Cable. I was promoted to Assistant Project Manager as soon as the project started. Once that project was complete I decided to part ways with Holder Construction to pursue other options.

When I started looking for jobs I knew I wanted to change things up and try a different role in the same industry. After interviewing around, I chose Adolfson and Peterson Construction in Denver CO to be hired on as a Estimator. Since then I have worked on numerous different projects across all sectors including commercial office, K-12, higher education, healthcare, and municipal. The highlights of my work since starting with AP include taking the preconstruction leads on PlatteFifteen ($43M), Dillon Hilton Homewood Suites ($22M), Wiggins High and Middle School ($26M) Silverthorne Performing Arts Center ($10M), Vail Health Edwards ($7M), numerous other small healthcare projects and assisting my managers on numerous other large scale projects.
